name: ryu.cloudflare-browser-run
description: Hosted Browser Run quick actions over Cloudflare's remote OAuth MCP server. Adds URL-scoped navigate, snapshot, and screenshot verbs to Ryu's swappable browser.control layer; the full Browser Run MCP tool set remains available under cloudflare.*.

cloudflare.description: Cloudflare Browser Run remote OAuth MCP server. Native tools include HTML, Markdown, PDF, snapshot, screenshot, JSON, links, crawl, and browser-session operations.
